record.question: An example of ex-situ conservation is
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation: Ex-situ conservation keeps biological material outside its natural habitat. CBD defines the term that way, and FAO identifies seed banks as an ex-situ conservation method. A seed bank therefore fits; a protected natural site is an in-situ example.
